prose:
The accessible New York Times opening describes founders and investors worrying that Huang’s departure could remove an ally who supplied capital and computing resources. It reports that Nvidia held $48 billion of stakes in 229 private companies at the end of July, citing securities filings.

The article stops at an access gate. A larger cloud-backstop figure appears in the feed headline but cannot be checked against the body here; concern about future support does not mean announced investments have been canceled.
highlights: Future investment cuts are not confirmed
basis: Feed metadata and accessible excerpt only; full article unavailable or incomplete.
